meta.unit: leaf; rust = abaxial face of the 21 diseased test leaves; American leaf spot = mean of both faces of the 55 diseased test leaves
meta.difference: predicted - reference severity, percentage points (pp); A = mean of predicted and reference
meta.severity_definition: lesion px / leaf px in 1024 x 1024 letterbox space (reference and prediction each over its own leaf mask), as in the published evaluation
meta.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of leaves, percentile 95% CIs, numpy default_rng(20260927); one index matrix per disease (rust drawn first), shared by the three models
meta.regression_loa: Bland & Altman (1999) section 3.2: D_hat = b0 + b1*A (OLS); |residual| = c0 + c1*A (OLS); SD(A) = sqrt(pi/2)*(c0 + c1*A); LoA(A) = D_hat(A) +/- 1.96*SD(A)
meta.ccc: Lin (1989), 1/n moments; CI: bootstrap percentile (primary) and Fisher-z with Lin's asymptotic variance (Lin 1989, corrected 2000); Cb = CCC / Pearson r
meta.decomposition: D = FP% - FN% + L; FP%, FN% = false-positive / false-negative lesion px as % of the reference leaf; L = 100*pred_lesion*(1/pred_leaf - 1/ref_leaf) (leaf-mask term); exact per face; FP split into spurious components (no overlap with any reference lesion), a 2-px boundary band around reference lesions, and extension beyond 2 px
meta.boundary_f1: lesion boundary = mask minus 3x3 erosion; tolerance Euclidean distance in 1024x1024 letterbox px; rust images 791x1024 (letterbox scale 1.0, 2 px = 2 native px); leaf-spot images 1583x2048 (scale 0.5, 2 px = 4 native px)
meta.pooled_iou: sum of lesion intersections / sum of lesion unions over all images in the leaf-level analysis (rust: 21 abaxial images; leaf spot: 110 images)
meta.healthy_note: Only 21 of the 54 healthy rust-test leaves reported in the paper are present locally; the healthy-leaf summary below covers those 21 (EARTH site) and does not replace the published 54-leaf specificity counts.

healthy_definitions_note: Two leaf-level definitions give different counts for the same 21 leaves: abaxial face only (the rust leaf-level rule used everywhere else in this analysis) and maximum over both faces (revision_brief.md fact 10). Use one, state it, and do not mix the two. The healthy leaves come from the EARTH site, the diseased rust leaves from Sarchi, so healthy-leaf false alarms are not a site-matched estimate of spurious detections on diseased leaves; for that see error_decomposition_pct_of_leaf.fp_spurious_pct.
